meta.rationale: An 8-bit title screen: pixel mountains scroll by, the logo bounces, and your apps are the game menu.
meta.theme-about: 8-bit arcade title screen: a full-screen canvas of chunky pixel art (a night sky with blocky stars, parallax pixel mountains and clouds scrolling sideways, a pixel moon), a big blocky logo, the apps as a centred game menu of uppercase entries with a blinking arrow cursor beside the hovered one, 'PRESS START' blinking, a HI-SCORE line with the time at the top; hard pixel edges, a four-colour NES-like palette, windows with thick pixel-step borders. Retro gaming, fun. (#game, #menu, #score)

desktop.canvas: local P = 8 local function px(x, y, wd, ht, c) g.rect(math.floor(x / P) * P, math.floor(y / P) * P, wd * P, ht * P, c) end local LOGO = { "XXXX XXX XX XX XXXX X ", "X X X X X X X ", "XXXX X X XXX X ", "X X X X X X ", "X XXX XX XX XXXX XXXX", } function draw(w, h, t) g.gradient(0, 0, w, h, "#0a0618", "#2a1a5c") for i = 0, 60 do local sx, sy = (i * 157) % w, (i * 89) % (h * 0.5) if (math.floor(t * 2 + i) % 5) ~= 0 then px(sx, sy, 1, 1, i % 3 == 0 and "#f8b800" or "#fcfcfc") end end px(w * 0.8, h * 0.12, 8, 8, "#fcfcfc") px(w * 0.8 + 16, h * 0.12 + 8, 3, 3, "#c8c8e8") local function range(speed, base, amp, col, period) local off = (t * speed) % (period * P) for x = -period * P, w + period * P, P do local xx = x - off local k = math.floor((x) / P) local hh = math.floor(amp * (math.abs(((k % period) - period / 2)) / (period / 2))) px(xx, base - hh * P, 1, hh + 60, col) end end range(12, h * 0.72, 14, "#3c2a8c", 28) range(30, h * 0.84, 9, "#1e5a3a", 16) g.rect(0, h * 0.9, w, h * 0.1, "#0f3a24") for i = 0, 3 do local cx = ((i * 420 + t * 20) % (w + 300)) - 150 px(cx, h * 0.25 + i * 30, 10, 2, "#fcfcfc") px(cx + 2 * P, h * 0.25 + i * 30 - P, 5, 1, "#fcfcfc") end local bob = math.floor(math.sin(t * 3) * 2) * P local lx = w / 2 - #LOGO[1] * P * 1.5 / 2 for r, line in ipairs(LOGO) do for c = 1, #line do if line:sub(c, c) == "X" then g.rect(lx + (c - 1) * 12 + 4, 92 + (r - 1) * 12 + bob + 4, 12, 12, "#e40058") g.rect(lx + (c - 1) * 12, 92 + (r - 1) * 12 + bob, 12, 12, "#f8b800") end end end if math.floor(t * 2) % 2 == 0 then g.text(w / 2 - 92, h * 0.88, "PRESS START", "#fcfcfc", 26, "JetBrainsMono") end end
